post.summary: Define an airport service product type (catalog)
post.description: Creates the Draft catalog definition of an airport service product: A20 Lounge, A21 Fast track, A22 CIP meet and assist. The definition carries no price, no point of sale and no stock: sale rules are AncillaryProvisions, rates are AncillaryPricings and stock is configured in the inventory resources.

put.summary: Change a Draft airport service product type (catalog)
put.description: Replaces the editable fields of a Draft airport service definition. The body is the form member of GET AirportService/{serviceDefinitionId} and can be sent back as it was read.

get.summary: Read an airport service product type for editing (catalog)
get.description: Returns the state of the definition and its form. The form has exactly the members of the PUT body and its specification holds only the fields of the variant. A definition of another profile answers 409 with code 16219.
